mentions.name: One Simulator
mentions.description: A One Piece TCG simulator that runs entirely in the browser, offering online matchmaking, spectating, ranked play, a deck builder, replays, and alternate card art, playable from a link on any device with no installation.
mentions.problem: Playing the game online previously required installing a PC client, sideloading an iPhone app, or using a tabletop sandbox with manual rule enforcement, and opponents had to do the same. Implementing card rulings is also difficult because printed card text differs from actual behavior, and new sets arriving almost monthly add piles of special cases to implement and test by hand.
mentions.audience: TCG players who want to play matches online without installing clients or enforcing rules manually
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on One Simulator (https://onesimulator.slidingcodes.com), a One Piece TCG simulator that runs entirely in the browser: online matchmaking, spectating, ranked, deck builder, replays (and alt cards you can flex on your opponent).
mentions.author: DopeTitanium
